import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')

m=w.merge(p[['work_id','dt','passage_id','confidence']],on='work_id'); print('agree',(m.dt==(m[c]>0)).mean())
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late)); print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()

rng=np.random.default_rng(0); grp=[x.r.values for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]; keys=list(w.groupby(['genre','late']).groups)

for i in range(2000):
  mm={k:rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for k,v in zip(keys,grp)}
  gs=set(k[0] for k in keys); bs.append(np.mean([mm[(g,True)]-mm[(g,False)] for g in gs]))

for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
print(est(w[(w.year>=1856)&(w.year<1896)]))
print(w.groupby(w.decade).r.agg(['mean','size']))
print('ex1876',est(w[w.year!=1876]))
